note: Recorded on 22-23 Nov 2026. The four small programs ran offline in a fake sandbox (a real node process, no network). The 60-program table ran on real E2B.

thrown-error.why: The caller needs the real error to decide what to do next.

printed-markers.why: Printed text that looks like the result markers replaces the real return value. This patch does not change it.

bigint-date.code: return await test.inspect({ big: 10n, at: new Date(0) });
bigint-date.why: Values with no JSON form fail on the way through the bridge. This patch only makes the failure say why.
bigint-date.fix: error: Do not know how to serialize a BigInt

never-answers.why: A tool call that never answers. The VM never applies the timeout to an awaited call, so it does not return in 4 s. E2B ends it.
